locus_B: the same table's LNP #2-#5 (80/5/15, 80/10/10, 80/15/5, 80/18/2) and the identical ratio block at Screen 1 LNP #1 (80/0/20)

The parallel block in Screen 1 has 0 cholesterol at the same position, so '1.5' is probably a typo for '0' - but that is an inference, so the printed value stands and the flag is carried.

locus_B: the same table's LNP 143: 90 + 0.5 + 3.5 + 5 = 99; the other 152 rows sum to exactly 100
what_we_emitted: The printed values, unaltered, with molpct_sum carried in 01_formulations.csv.
why: MEASURED: 418 of 424 formulations sum to exactly 100. The four 101s are the SAME ratio repeated across the four helper lipids (DOPE/DOPC/DSPC/18:1 Lyso) at a fixed stride of 16 - the signature of one error in a block that was pasted four times, not four independent errors. pdfplumber's grid cells and an independent extract_text() read of the same page return identical digits, so the anomaly is the paper's, not the extraction's.
